record.name: Morrow
record.appearance: tan skin, white bob, green eyes, an angular cheek mark, gold earrings, a red braided collar cord, glossy ivory and black high-cut armor, black gauntlets, white mechanical thigh-high boots, a smoky cape with blood-red lining, a control orb and translucent mint tendrils ending in black and crimson sensory heads; the Mourning Leviathan is a separate commanded summon (ivory crescent carapace, black ribbed hollows, mint ocular gems and hanging bone-like tendrils) and Morrow does not become it

passive.name: brood sense
passive.description: Maintain three sensory nodes. Each reveals ordinary movement within 3 m (300 cm) and earns Absence under the core rule. Enemies can face a node to stop its charging or destroy it. Morrow turns finite attention into a defensive resource while opponents retain control of their actions.
passive.notes: Core rule (skill-paradigms.md): Observation. Three visible Brood nodes each break to one hostile direct damaging hit (one hit point) and reform beside Morrow after 6 s (180 ticks); they stay within 10 m (1000 cm) of her. Nodes persist until broken, so the carrier lifetime is 0. Absence is a global reserve of three; it is spent to move the leviathan while Watched and to feint with Pale Grasp. Passive forms carry rules, not a skill behaviour: the draft form behaviour was removed on promotion; it recorded rank 0 statuses[0].ticks = 30 (the reveal is continuous while an enemy stays within 3 m (300 cm) of a node; 30 ticks is a refreshing placeholder.); rank 0 observation = "Watched: enemy within 1200 cm, clear sight, aim within 30 degrees; unwatched node within 600 cm earns one Absence after 45 ticks (once per node per 120 ticks); reserve three" (schema cannot express observation: a node or leviathan core is Watched when an enemy within 12 m has clear line of sight and aims within 30 degrees of it, read from ordinary combat facing (never the camera or the HUD). An unwatched node within 6 m of an enemy earns one Absence after 1.5 s, at most once per node every 4 s; the global reserve is three Absence; no nearby enemy means no charge farming.); rank 0 statuses: revealed 30 ticks; rank 3 statuses[0].ticks = 30 (the reveal is continuous while an enemy stays within 3 m (300 cm) of a node; 30 ticks is a refreshing placeholder.); rank 3 observation = "Watched: enemy within 1200 cm, clear sight, aim within 30 degrees; unwatched node within 600 cm earns one Absence after 45 ticks (once per node per 120 ticks); reserve three" (schema cannot express observation: a node or leviathan core is Watched when an enemy within 12 m has clear line of sight and aims within 30 degrees of it, read from ordinary combat facing (never the camera or the HUD). An unwatched node within 6 m of an enemy earns one Absence after 1.5 s, at most once per node every 4 s; the global reserve is three Absence; no nearby enemy means no charge farming.); rank 3 aimEcho = "node watched for 22.5 ticks stores the watcher's firing direction for 60 ticks" (schema cannot express a recorded aim: a node watched for 0.75 s (22.5 ticks) records that enemy's firing direction as an Aim Echo for 2 s (60 ticks), drawn as a faint ground line; each node stores only its latest echo; suppressing Absence offers Morrow a temporarily borrowed angle for Pale Grasp.); rank 3 statuses: revealed 30 ticks; rank 5 statuses[0].ticks = 30 (the reveal is continuous while an enemy stays within 3 m (300 cm) of a node; 30 ticks is a refreshing placeholder.); rank 5 observation = "Watched: enemy within 1200 cm, clear sight, aim within 30 degrees; unwatched node within 600 cm earns one Absence after 45 ticks (once per node per 120 ticks); reserve three" (schema cannot express observation: a node or leviathan core is Watched when an enemy within 12 m has clear line of sight and aims within 30 degrees of it, read from ordinary combat facing (never the camera or the HUD). basic.name: pale grasp
basic.description: Lash a tendril for 70 damage from Morrow or a chosen live node. The target must be within 3 m (300 cm) of that origin; the visible physical path cannot pass through solid cover. Aim a primary at legal ground instead to reposition one node inside its 10 m (1000 cm) leash, sacrificing the attack.

signature.name: leviathan descent
signature.description: Manifest the leviathan for 8 s (240 ticks), its core within 10 m (1000 cm) and local gameplay footprint no wider than 6 m (600 cm); its city-scale presence is visual. Its separate health equals 40% of Morrow's maximum health. It advances along a legal route at 2 m/s (200 cm/s) only while its core is unwatched. dossier.identity: pale brood attention-siege bastion who keeps three sensory nodes and turns the enemy's own gaze into a resource to move a commanded horror
dossier.selectionRationale: The 2026-11-07 dossier proposals (docs/dossier-proposals/2026-11-07) make Morrow a bastion whose defence is attention: enemies spend aim to restrain the Mourning Leviathan, steal angles from her nodes and feed her movement by watching the wrong target. Protection comes from misdirected aim and a killable moving screen, not permanent armor, distinct from aegis's and iris's static walls.
dossier.weaponConcept: control orb with an appendage control unit (shoulder-socket mutation interface driving translucent mint tendrils that end in black and crimson sensory heads), commanding the Mourning Leviathan, a separate colossal horror summon
dossier.loreStatus: draft lore composed from the supplied dossier sheet and the 2026-11-07 proposals; not owner-reviewed

lore.backstory: Morrow keeps a pale brood: sensory nodes that watch the people who watch them, and a colossal horror that moves when it is forgotten. The supplied sheet lists horror summoning, tactical control, battlefield denial and reconnaissance in urban operations.
lore.syndicateRecord: No syndicate record in the supplied sheet; the Mourning Leviathan is recorded as a city-scale, reality-distorting presence that obeys its summoner's will.
lore.psychProfile: Patient and unhurried: she lets the enemy choose where to look and takes what they give up, and she does not confuse a watched monster with a harmless one.
lore.combatQuote: “they do not rest. neither do we.”

dossier.identity: pale brood attention-siege bastion who keeps three sensory nodes and turns the enemy's own gaze into a resource to move a commanded horror
dossier.selectionRationale: The 2026-11-07 dossier proposals (docs/dossier-proposals/2026-11-07) make Morrow a bastion whose defence is attention: enemies spend aim to restrain the Mourning Leviathan, steal angles from her nodes and feed her movement by watching the wrong target. Protection comes from misdirected aim and a killable moving screen, not permanent armor, distinct from aegis's and iris's static walls.
dossier.weaponConcept: control orb with an appendage control unit (shoulder-socket mutation interface driving translucent mint tendrils that end in black and crimson sensory heads), commanding the Mourning Leviathan, a separate colossal horror summon
dossier.loreStatus: draft lore composed from the supplied dossier sheet and the 2026-11-07 proposals; not owner-reviewed

lore.backstory: Morrow keeps a pale brood: sensory nodes that watch the people who watch them, and a colossal horror that moves when it is forgotten. The supplied sheet lists horror summoning, tactical control, battlefield denial and reconnaissance in urban operations.
lore.syndicateRecord: No syndicate record in the supplied sheet; the Mourning Leviathan is recorded as a city-scale, reality-distorting presence that obeys its summoner's will.
lore.psychProfile: Patient and unhurried: she lets the enemy choose where to look and takes what they give up, and she does not confuse a watched monster with a harmless one.
lore.combatQuote: “they do not rest. neither do we.”

iconFamily.subject: a bold leviathan eye over a single chunky tendril knot
iconFamily.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: one base raster concept for a game ability icon, to be traced into SVG. Character: Morrow. Theme: pale brood. Subject: a bold leviathan eye over a single chunky tendril knot. Centered compact square silhouette, fills 82% of canvas. Flat solid black monochromatic ink on genuinely transparent background. Exceptionally bold clean outer contour, broad shapes and large negative-space gaps. Recognizable at 24 to 30 pixels. No tiny details, thin lines, text, badges, borders, HUD elements, colored accents, gradients, shadows, textures or 3D. ONE original base emblem, not a sheet or variants. All four subsequent ability variations must keep this same identifiable theme.
iconFamily.method: built-in image generation, then silhouette tracing, then four SVG variations
